The retrieved pre-2020 posts cluster into a few recurring narrative threads:

- Politics & election commentary: mockery of liberal anti-Trump protests [T4-008314](#T4-008314), pro-Trump sentiment directed at Canadian politics ("Canada needs a TRUMP!") [T4-009012](#T4-009012), praise-style listicles about Trump [T4-000365](#T4-000365), dismissal of Megyn Kelly's book as "#FAKENEWS" [T4-009474](#T4-009474), and a claim that Hollande "will be completely irrelevant in 6 weeks" [T4-007303](#T4-007303).
- Conspiracy / QAnon-style framing: an "eye in the sky" over the "Rothschild manor" aircraft wreckage with "multiple casualties," tagged #CalmBeforeTheStorm, #FollowTheWhiteRabbit, #TheStormIsUponUs [T4-008927](#T4-008927).
- Social justice reaction: a post decrying something as "disgusting" alongside #BlackLivesMatter [T4-009393](#T4-009393); a reproductive-choice statement about a woman's right to decide for herself and her child [T4-006136](#T4-006136).
- News/current events: Southern California brush fire with some evacuations lifted [T4-002151](#T4-002151); a food-safety complaint about no turkey meat, tagged #KochFarms #USDA [T4-001196](#T4-001196).
- Music/entertainment and event promotion: a Carnegie Hall concert listing (Michael Olatuja & Lagos Pepper Soup, Jan 23, 2017) [T4-005807](#T4-005807) and a track release "Lil Yachty – Terminator" [T4-005245](#T4-005245).
- Commercial/spam-like listings: limousine reservation/service ads [T4-002029](#T4-002029) [T4-001938](#T4-001938).
- Everyday personal/social chatter: an exercise-ball purchase joke [T4-000510](#T4-000510), a "#SmallWorld" retweet of a former student [T4-004058](#T4-004058), a fraternity/alumni remark [T4-005523](#T4-005523), and a brief remark that "there were no victims" [T4-002970](#T4-002970).
- Low-content/link-only posts with no discernible narrative [T4-001160](#T4-001160) [T4-009051](#T4-009051).

Note this is a bounded retrieval sample of 9,336 matching posts, not a representative sample, so these threads reflect the retrieved subset only.
